title: Deaths Counter DataPack
description: This is data pack add deaths counter.
body:
With this is datapack you can add Deaths Score. You can use him in Challenges!
To load DataPack you need:
1. Download dataPack
2. Move to .minecraft > saves > (Your World) > datapacks 
3. Copy dataPack to "datapacks" folder
4. If your world working and you add DataPack you need rejoin into the world
5. Done

[Official CurseForge DataPack](https://curseforge.com/minecraft/data-packs/deaths-counter-datapack)
